items.actClause:
AN ACT authorizing the use of sewer surplus for infrastructure projects other
than sewer projects in the village of Baldwinsville; and providing for the
repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S5405

SPONSOR: MANNION
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act authorizing the use of sewer surplus for infrastructure projects
other than sewer projects in the village of Baldwinsville; and providing
for the repeal of such provisions upon     expiration thereof

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

This legislation will allow for the Village of Baldwinsville to use
their sewer funds for other municipal purposes since the County of Onon-
daga is taking over the administration of the sewers

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1. Allows the village of Baldwinsville to use revenues from
their sewer fund towards municipality infrastructure improvements.

Section 2. Effective Date

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Current law states a municipality's sewer rents, charges, penalties and
interest cannot be used for any purpose other than sewer related
purposes. This is in stark contrast to water utility funding which may
be credited to a municipality's infrastructure funding.

In Onondaga County, the County is consolidating all local municipal
sewer systems under the County. Due to the County taking over the main-
tenance and operation of the Baldwinsville sewers, the village of Bald-
winsville will no longer have need of a dedicated sewer fund.

Ultimately, this will prevent stranded assets in the Village's sewer
fund. Under this legislation, the Village of Baldwinsville will be
authorized to transfer sewer funds to other village infrastructure
projects over a period of a year, after which this law will be repealed.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS FOR STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS:

To be determined

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect on the 60th day that it shall have become law
and shall expire and be deemed repealed one year after such date.
